title: ZeroMesh
summary: Meshtastic messenger for the M5Stack CardputerZero Cap LoRa-1262
description: Off-grid Meshtastic messenger for the M5Stack CardputerZero with the Cap LoRa-1262. It runs full screen on the Zero's 320×170 display, uses its keyboard, and talks to meshtasticd on the device. No phone and no internet needed.
